title: Property Tax Installment Due-Soon Queue
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=propertytax:installment
| eval days_to_due=round((installment_due_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_due>=0 AND days_to_due<=30
| table _time county days_to_due
| sort days_to_due
description: Builds a short queue of upcoming deadlines tied to property tax installment.
value: Property work is deadline-heavy, so a due-soon queue keeps you from missing payments, approvals, or decision windows.
implementation: Populate `due_epoch` from the upstream portal or your checklist export.
visualization: Table of upcoming deadlines by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which property tax installment deadlines are coming up soon.
